# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 D3 colonisation framework (phase 1, resettlement). Generated by gen_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. The empire is quiet enough to resettle land: it holds Constantinople, no civil war (vanilla or the 1341 / 1352 lines), no crisis of the vassal line (as C4's oe_glh_byz_calm).
oe_col_calm = {
    location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { var:oe_vas_stage ?= 2 }
}

# Location scope. Old Roman land: one of the 39 historical regions, a former province of the outer circle, or reclaimed land still waiting to be settled.
oe_col_old_land = {
    OR = { has_variable = oe_theme_region has_variable = oe_tw_former_province has_variable = oe_trc_pending }
}

# Location scope. Reclaimed land (the reclaim track's marks): chosen first.
oe_col_reclaimed = {
    OR = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending oe_trc_settled = yes }
}

# Location scope. Vanilla's raid modifiers are on it.
oe_col_raided = {
    OR = { has_location_modifier = looted has_location_modifier = recovering_from_raids }
}

# Location scope. Sparse land that may take settlers: Byzantium's own (owner and controller), land, not Constantinople itself nor Mount Athos (r15), old Roman land, and thin (under oe_col_sparse_pop thousand people), raided, reclaimed, or not mainly Orthodox; and not resettled in the last 20 years (oe_col_cd).
oe_col_sparse = {
    owner ?= c:BYZ
    controller ?= c:BYZ
    is_land = yes
    NOT = { this = location:constantinople }
    NOT = { this = location:mount_athos }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_cd }
    oe_col_old_land = yes
    OR = {
        population < oe_col_sparse_pop
        oe_col_raided = yes
        oe_col_reclaimed = yes
        NOT = { dominant_religion = religion:orthodox }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Some sparse land exists.
oe_col_has_sparse = {
    any_owned_location = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
}

# Location scope. In great region 1, Thrace (historical regions 1-4).
oe_col_in_thrace = {
    OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 1 var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 var:oe_theme_region ?= 3 var:oe_theme_region ?= 4 }
}

# BYZ scope. One of the two migration slots is free.
oe_col_slot_free = {
    OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } }
}

# BYZ scope. The action (and the AI's yearly roll) may start a resettlement.
oe_col_can_resettle = {
    oe_col_calm = yes
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 2 }
    gold >= oe_col_cost_in
    oe_col_slot_free = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_act_cd }
    oe_col_has_sparse = yes
}

# Location scope. Albania, northern Greece or the Morea.
oe_col_albanian_lands = {
    OR = { area = area:albania_area area = area:northern_greece_area area = area:morea_area }
}

# Location scope. Great region 6, eastern Anatolia (historical regions 27-37).
oe_col_east_lands = {
    has_variable = oe_theme_region
    var:oe_theme_region >= 27
    var:oe_theme_region <= 37
}

# Any scope. The imperial bloc holds land in Albania, northern Greece or the Morea.
oe_col_g1_bloc = {
    OR = {
        area:albania_area = { any_location_in_area = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:northern_greece_area = { any_location_in_area = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:morea_area = { any_location_in_area = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Steppe riders may come: the Golden Horde's great troubles (C4's global oe_glh_troubles = 1, or vanilla's horde civil war), or the imperial bloc holds land on the steppe.
oe_col_g2_ok = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_troubles global_var:oe_glh_troubles = 1 }
        AND = { country_exists = c:GLH c:GLH = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:horde_civil_war } }
        region:steppes_region = { any_location_in_region = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Armenians may come wherever: the imperial bloc holds land in the Armenian highlands or Cilicia, or Armenian Cilicia has fallen (from 1375).
oe_col_g3_bloc = {
    OR = {
        area:armenian_highlands_area = { any_location_in_area = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:cilicia_area = { any_location_in_area = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        AND = { current_date >= 1375.1.1 NOT = { country_exists = c:CIL } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. Albanians may come to the target.
oe_col_g1_ok = {
    OR = { oe_col_g1_bloc = yes scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_albanian_lands = yes } }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. Armenians may come to the target.
oe_col_g3_ok = {
    OR = { oe_col_g3_bloc = yes scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_east_lands = yes } }
}

# Location scope. A queued quarrel is due here: still ours, the settlers' modifier still on, the month reached.
oe_col_dsp_ready = {
    has_variable = oe_col_dsp
    has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due
    owner ?= c:BYZ
    OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
    var:oe_col_dsp_due <= oe_ml_month_now
}

# BYZ scope. The trigger of oe_col.1 (oe_col_fire_1 checks it too).
oe_col_ev_ok_1 = {
    var:oe_col_target ?= { owner ?= c:BYZ }
}

# BYZ scope. The trigger of oe_col.2 (oe_col_fire_2 checks it too).
oe_col_ev_ok_2 = {
    var:oe_col_dsp_loc ?= { owner ?= c:BYZ }
}

# BYZ scope. The trigger of oe_col.10 (oe_col_fire_10 checks it too).
oe_col_ev_ok_10 = {
    any_owned_location = { has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees }
}

# BYZ scope. An optional event of this line may come this month: from 1338.1.1, the line is quiet (oe_col_ev_cd, 6 months after the last one), the empire calm, the main-line month free.
oe_col_ev_free = {
    current_date >= 1338.1.1
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ev_cd }
    oe_col_calm = yes
    oe_ml_free = yes
}

# BYZ scope. The AI may resettle this year: rich enough, authority to spare, a free slot, sparse land, the line and the main-line month free.
oe_col_ai_ok = {
    is_ai = yes
    current_date >= 1338.1.1
    oe_col_can_resettle = yes
    gold >= oe_col_ai_gold
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 15 }
    oe_ml_free = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle: the framework is under way (from 1338.1.1, books started).
oe_col_chr_run = {
    has_variable = oe_col_on
    current_date >= 1338.1.1
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle: void while the empire does not hold Constantinople (the line only keeps its books then; it resumes if the City is retaken).
oe_col_chr_void = {
    has_variable = oe_col_on
    NOT = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
}
